ops.title: Scope retireUntrusted's eviction to the refusing daemon's own label
ops.description:
deploy.Reset's retireUntrusted recovers from a daemon whose Trust.Control refuses this client by converge(ctx, nil): it boots out EVERY label in appliedServices(), while d.settle proves only the primary d.client identity gone. In a multi-agent deployment, unrelated healthy agents are force-evicted with no absence proof specific to them.

Scoping the eviction to the refusing daemon's label is not expressible today: nothing in deploy correlates Config.Daemon.Label with Config.Agents[i].Label — that mapping exists only in tests, so fixing this is a Config-level API change (a daemon-to-agent mapping), out of scope for the Reset recovery change that introduced retireUntrusted.

Note the tension: Client.Stop states the opposite policy (stop.go:28-30 — an attach the ladder cannot classify, such as an untrusted peer holding the socket, propagates and nothing is removed over it). Reset is the explicit recovery verb, so the blast radius is documented on retireUntrusted's doc comment rather than hidden, and the destructive step that follows remains gated by Reset's requireEmpty().

ops.text: retireUntrusted (or its successor) evicts only the refusing daemon's own label, backed by a Config-level daemon-to-agent mapping
an absence proof covers each label actually retired
